summary: Lists detected audio input and output devices by driver, direction, label, and name for use with Audio Device In and Audio Device Out CHOPs.

key_params.name: driver
key_params.note: Filter table to default, ASIO, DataPath, Blackmagic, AJA, or Deltacast devices

key_params.name: alldrivers
key_params.note: Show devices from all available drivers

key_params.name: input
key_params.note: Include input devices in the table

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Include output devices in the table

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Script run when the device table changes

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: External editor extension exposed by the DAT

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Device names and labels are machine-dependent; generated Audio Device CHOPs should reference current table values.
All Drivers can show duplicate-looking hardware across different driver backends.
Callbacks may fire for hotplug or driver-state changes, so scripts should debounce if they rebuild audio routing.
Some listed drivers depend on OS, hardware, or vendor drivers that may not be installed.
key_concepts: Lists detected audio devices with driver, direction, label, and name fields.
Can show one selected driver or all available audio-device drivers.
Runs a callback once for each table/device-state change and reports changed device names.
The listed names are intended for Audio Device In CHOP and Audio Device Out CHOP device references.
platform_notes: Available driver choices are platform and hardware dependent; the default driver entry maps to DirectSound/CoreAudio in the official docs.
